graph_nodes_text: At the top are the main results the repository names in its last step. Below them, each box is one Lean file.

spine_lines_text: A line means the upper result rests on the lower one, directly or through steps not drawn here. Lean also uses results it fills in on its own without naming them; those are not counted, so a result can rest on more than its lines show. Every line drawn is real.
